rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. The 2 iter1 regressions are test-data drift, not code regressions: (1) repeated runs of TestApprovals in iter1 decide all pending approvals so seed-based count drops to 0 (assertion >=1 was overly tight); (2) seed activities have hardcoded calendar dates (around 2026-01-12 etc.) so on dates outside that window the grid pre-population legitimately yields 0 rows.
